name: Prince of the Resort
source:
Those ikemen who showed up are all... Princes!?
Prince of the Resort - Love simulation otome game for women

Aquria is famous for its celebrity resort.
A bunch of princes appear in front of you, working at the Resort as a concierge!

"Will you become my private concierge?"

You'll be at the Prince's mercy 24/7.
And as you spend more and more time with him, you end up uncovering his secrets....
When everything becomes clear, hiding your feelings becomes impossible!

Overcoming your differences in status, your love story will turn out to be...

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dearead.rst.en]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
那些出現的帥哥竟然全是……王子！？

《度假村王子》——一款女性向戀愛模擬遊戲。

阿克利亞以名人度假村聞名。一群王子作為度假村的禮賓專員，出現在你面前！

「你願意成為我的私人禮賓專員嗎？」

你將全天候受王子支配。隨著和他共度的時間越來越多，你會發現他的秘密……
當一切真相大白，隱藏自己的感情就不可能了！

跨越身分差異後，你們的愛情故事將走向……

[來源：[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dearead.rst.en]Google Play[/url]]
